title: Test and evidence contracts
summary: Source commands stopped by a signal name that signal and return 128 plus its number. Disposable PostgreSQL setup refuses postgres_binaries_unavailable when initdb is absent from PATH or the pinned bin directory. The always-run contract floor includes the source-wide bounded deployment-run lock scan without the database contention tests. Config-bound Git credential helpers read the disposable source config through a child-only overlay that preserves helper order and leaves parent Git configuration unchanged. Native OS requirements use posix_only, windows_only, macos_only or linux_only with exactly one reason and one scope. Module scopes skip before import; hand-written OS skips and scoped-off baseline entries are refused. Only windows_only can accompany windows smoke. CI file groups retain modules skipped before import on the collection host so native OS runners still receive those files. CI coverage manifests explicitly include module collection skips and require them, like real tests, to appear exactly once in shard reports.
